name: Llama 4 Maverick (17B active, 128 experts)

release_date.note: model card 'Model Release Date'; the gallery gives the same date

params.note: total from the Hub safetensors count incl. the vision tower; card and blog: 400B total, 17B active; derived text stack 400,711,848,960 total and 17,184,691,200 active

moe.dense_layers: every other layer: 0-based 0, 2, ..., 46 (24 layers) keep a dense SwiGLU of width 16384
moe.router: top-1 of 128; the sigmoid of the chosen logit scales the token before the expert

stack.note: chunked = RoPE + attention within 8,192-token chunks; global_nope = full attention without RoPE; MoE on odd layers (config moe_layers)

steps.label: 40 query heads, 8 KV heads; RoPE + 8,192-token chunks on 3 of 4 layers; NoPE + full context + query temperature scaling on every 4th

specials.name: chunked_attention
specials.what: tokens attend only inside fixed 8,192-token chunks (attention_chunk_size), not a sliding window

specials.name: nope
specials.what: no rotary embedding on every 4th layer; Meta calls the mix iRoPE

specials.name: shared_expert
specials.what: every token also passes through one shared expert

specials.name: vision_tower
specials.what: MetaCLIP-based encoder, early fusion of image tokens into the decoder

omitted_towers.what: vision encoder (34 layers, width 1408, patch 14, image 336) plus a projector to 5120

card.note: copy of Meta's card: 17B activated, 400B total, text and image in, 1M context, release April 5, 2025, Llama 4 Community License

blog.note: alternating dense and MoE layers; 128 routed experts and a shared expert, one routed per token; iRoPE; inference-time temperature scaling; MetaCLIP-based vision encoder; early fusion

code.note: Llama4TextDecoderLayer: input_layernorm, attention, residual, post_attention_layernorm, MoE or MLP, residual; Llama4TextMoe: shared_expert + routed; sigmoid router; temperature tuning on NoPE layers

ccode.note: no_rope_layers: 1 = RoPE, 0 = NoPE; layer_types chunked_attention for RoPE layers, full_attention otherwise

idx.note: experts.gate_up_proj fused; shared_expert; router; dense feed_forward on non-MoE layers; vision_model.*; total_size 803,167,562,752 bytes

gal.note: entry 'Llama 4 Maverick': date, '36 chunked + 12 full GQA', 1,000,000 context

count.note: text: 2*V*d + L*(2*d*h*hd + 2*d*kv*hd + 2d) + 24*3*d*16384 + 24*(128d + 129*3*d*8192) + d; active drops 127 experts in 24 layers; vision = index total_size/2 minus text (assumes all tensors bf16)

hfapi.note: safetensors total 401,583,781,376, all BF16 (= index total_size / 2)

figure_links.author: Sebastian Raschka
figure_links.title: Llama 4 Maverick
figure_links.terms: no reuse licence stated; link only

unknowns.tokenizer.kind: card, blog and config do not name the tokenizer algorithm

notes: Config field no_rope_layers is named backwards: 1 marks a RoPE layer (configuration_llama4.py).
use_qk_norm is false for Maverick; the code applies L2 q/k norm only when it is true (Scout).

global_nope_moe.note: full context; query temperature scaling (attn_scale 0.1, floor 8192)
